sec: sec:E015: Log AI system activity / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:E015: Log AI system activity / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Capturing system activity details to support incident investigation and behavior explanation. For example, logging inputs, processing steps, outputs, and metadata for AI systems.

sentences.text: Capturing system activity details to support incident investigation and behavior explanation.
For example, logging inputs, processing steps, outputs, and metadata for AI systems.

blocks.id: blk:E015: Log AI system activity / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Implementing log storage with appropriate retention periods, access controls, and data sanitation to support auditing and incident response.
